facts.fact: 神之催用：Orsus 耳语「Use them. Use me.」——Rian 的六芒 sigil（Orsus 符+Phos 光符居中）拉兄脱险——Julian 感到 aether+lightspeed 同启。
弃弓纵魔：Julian 掷弓退 Fin——「Get back...You’re distracting him.」——demon rose, starved——黑筋自腕蔓上颈胸——「you can be both」的实践：魔未全占（craving 生于后槽牙）。
攀兽驭兽：箭攀兽背——compulsion「Stop struggling. Retreat.」无效（兽不能聚焦）——叉上顶眼一箭。
神之讥弄：「Are you nothing but an animal?...This is what you would debase yourself to?」——demon 恶意嘲笑声淹过神声——换来一瞬清明（想 Rian 的 sigil 何以双符同在）。
facts.anchor: Are you nothing but an animal?

facts.fact: 梦符复现：祭司手势 superimposed——三角+radicals+六芒星——sigil 拍上 median eye——aether 导火下灌、火自甲缝爆出。
facts.anchor: His hand superimposed upon the memory

facts.fact: 借力合击：抓 Rian 之手同按 sigil——兽灭——「I can use Conjuration. Because of him.」「And now I can use it against him.」
facts.anchor: “I can use Conjuration. Because of him.”

facts.fact: Nikolas 三问：How had Rian teleported him away? / How had Nikolas been the one who needed saving again? / How could Julian do what Nikolas could not?——颈羽破皮寻光——Edwin 起绰号（The Lightbearer? The Winged Heir?...You are the Sunbringer）。
facts.anchor: How could Julian do what Nikolas could not?

facts.fact: 神罚与无感：Julian 崩跪（cuff 肿、黑筋被强压回）——「They're—stronger. Mad.」「Maybe once. Not anymore.」——Rian 持矛：「it was… different than how I remember」「I didn’t feel anything at all.」
facts.anchor: I didn’t feel anything at all.
